drawer.title: Configure audit · {{category}}
drawer.description: Advanced operating configuration. Changes apply to future audits.
drawer.sharedBudgetHint: One global token cap shared by all selected attributes. This setting is common to every audit category.
drawer.agentDefaultsHint: Applied to every agent in this category. max_output_tokens is the output token maximum per response, including managers and coordinators. An explicit individual value replaces the inherited value; no second model cap applies. In maintainability, model/tool call defaults apply to investigators; hierarchy limits above control manager and coordinator aggregate budgets.
drawer.defaultsHint: Leave a field empty to use server defaults. Exclusive settings of individual maintainability agents are configured separately.

audit.modelsDescription: Choose a model and credential for each quality category. Saving applies that selection to all its model agents declared by the server.
audit.categoryAssignment: Saving applies this model and credential to every model agent in this category, preserving individual operating parameters.
audit.categoryMixed: Agents in this category have different assignments. Save to apply the selected configuration to all of them.
audit.noCategories: The saved catalog has no configurable quality categories. Synchronize the agent catalog to load the category cards.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.editHint: When editing a credential, leave the API key blank to keep the current key.

agents.noModelRequired: This agent is deterministic and does not require model access.
agents.unavailable: This agent is not available for execution or model access verification.
agents.sharedModel: Uses the model and credential configured for {{agentType}}.
agents.title: Agent configuration
agents.subtitle: Agent types declared in the backend and their saved configuration.
agents.empty: No agent types are declared in the backend.

form.noCredentialsForProvider: No credentials registered for this provider

drawer.title: Configure {{agentType}}
drawer.description: Choose model access and generation parameters.
drawer.modelAccessHint: The model and credential must belong to the same provider.
drawer.generationHint: Leave a field empty to use the default value.
drawer.temperatureHint: 0–2 · Lower values produce more consistent results.
drawer.maxTokensHint: Maximum output tokens per response. Leave empty to inherit the audit or server configuration. An explicit value replaces the inherited value; it does not add another cap.
drawer.outputInheritanceError: Could not load the inherited limit. No estimated default is displayed.
drawer.outputInherited: {{category}}: {{value}} tokens per response, inherited from the audit.
drawer.maxTokensInvalid: Maximum tokens must be a positive integer, up to 2147483647.
drawer.tokenBudgetHint: Counts input and output across all model calls. Leave a field empty to clear its override.
drawer.tokenLimitsInvalid: Token limits must be positive integers, up to 2147483647.
drawer.limitsOrderInvalid: The absolute limit must be greater than or equal to the initial budget.
drawer.toleranceMarginStrict: Tolerance margin: {{margin}} tokens ({{percent}}%). Strict budget: no additional margin.
drawer.agentOptionsHint: Additional options specific to this agent will appear here when available.

errors.accessDenied: The provider rejected the credential or its permissions. Check the key and model access.
errors.invalidConfiguration: Invalid verification configuration. Check the provider, model and credential.
errors.modelNotFound: The model was not found or is unavailable for this credential.
errors.rateLimited: A provider rate limit or quota was reached. Access could not be confirmed.
errors.providerUnavailable: The provider is temporarily unavailable. Access could not be confirmed; try again later.
errors.timeout: The verification timed out. Access could not be confirmed; this does not mean the key is incorrect.
errors.verificationFailed: The model verification could not be completed. Access was not confirmed.
errors.agentServerUnavailable: The agent-server could not be reached in time. Model access was not confirmed.

verification.hint: Checks saved model access with a minimal provider request. Every execution checks again before starting.
verification.saveFirst: Save your changes before verifying access.

preferences.languageHint: Applies immediately and is saved on this device.

notifications.title: Task notifications
notifications.hint: Read-only tasks stay silent unless they fail. Failed tasks always show.
